summary: Coor Service Management Holding AB provides facility management services in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland. The company offers property and cleaning services, food and beverage services, workplace design, office and conference services, outdoor environment services, and security services. It also provides SmartClimate for indoor climate; SmartLaundry, which filters microplastics when washing; SmartEnergy for energy efficiency; SmartDrone for property inspections; SmartLighting to reduce energy use; and Carbon Insight, a tool for an overview of how emissions are distributed. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.
